answer.answer: The "Ishan Uday" Special Scholarship Scheme For North Eastern Region is a scholarship program with the following key details: [E01] Applicants must be domiciles of the North Eastern Region with parental annual income not exceeding ₹4,50,000/- per annum, and must have passed Class 12th or equivalent. [E01] The scholarship is provided for general degree courses and technical and professional courses, including medical and paramedical courses, at eligible universities, colleges, and institutes. [E01] Scholarships are renewed during the first degree course subject to good conduct and attendance, and students who fail to get promoted forfeit the scholarship. [E01] Change of course results in forfeiture of the scholarship. [E02] Payment is made through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). [E02] The application process is completely free and conducted online at https://scholarships.gov.in/. [E02] The North Eastern States eligible under the scheme are Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim and Tripura. [E03] Transgender candidates are eligible to apply, and reservation for Persons with Disability follows Government of India norms.
